# YSS236 (VOP3-2) microcode, FS1R v1.20 EPROM

Generated by `tools/extract_vop3_2.py`. **Reference material only.** The effects the emulator
ships are models, because nobody has decoded this instruction set. This is the effects chip's
program — the half of the VOP3 microcode nobody had looked at. VOP3-1's filter program is in
`docs/vop3_microcode.md`. The chip's pinout is in `docs/vop3_pinout.md`: unlike the filter
chip, this one has its external DRAM fitted, so a program here can be a reverb.

## Bus and boot (FUN_0003A064)

`FUN_00039648(reg, value)` writes `0x800000 + reg * 2`, a 16-bit register block. The boot init
writes register 1 (reset), register 5 = 0x1FF4, then fifteen per-bus levels out of EPROM
0x37101A into register 0x16 addressed per bus (bus + 1 selected through register 0), registers
0x28/0x29 held at 0x15 for the 15 buses, register 0x2A at 0, and finishes with register 1 = 0
and `FUN_0003A140(5, 1)`. The per-bus layout matches VOP3-1's boot for the same registers.

Per-bus levels, 0x37101A -> register 0x16:

```
42 44 1C 00 42 27 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 01
```

## The upload (FUN_0003C9C4)

512 steps of five 16-bit words each. Word k of step n sits at
`base + n*10 + k*2` and goes to register 10 - k (so the five words of a step land on
registers 10, 9, 8, 7 and 6, as on VOP3-1). Before each pass it writes register 0 with
0x8000. Image 0 at 0x373604 is uploaded on the normal boot; image 1 at 0x372204 from the
diagnostic entry, alongside VOP3-1's variant 1.

## The RAM-side finish

After the 512 steps the upload writes two coefficient addresses through `FUN_00039652(2,`
`0x3721FC)` — register 0xB gets a per-slot word out of `DAT_0106842c` — and four DRAM
addresses through `FUN_000397f4(4, 0x372200)`, which splits `DAT_0106882c[sel] + offset`
into register 0xD (high, >> 9) and register 0xE (low, & 0x1FF), the offset picked by the
selector map at 0x3720A4 (00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00). Those RAM tables are
populated as the parameter path runs, so the program's working data is effect-dependent.
The two address words at 0x3721FC are 0x00E9, 0x00EB and the four selectors at 0x372200
are 0x3436, 0x3537, 0x0000, 0x0000.

## The effect programs (FUN_00039C8A)

The boot image is a skeleton. The DSP code the unit runs is uploaded per effect type by
`FUN_00039C8A(kind, force)` into fixed program windows, and `docs/vop3_2/*.bin` holds it raw
(5 words per step, plus `*_bytes.bin` for register 0xC):

| kind | steps | types | program address | EPROM program | EPROM byte table |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| base | 0xE8 | 1 | 0x000 | 0x3658D4 | 0x3661E4 |
| reverb | 0x28 | 4 | 0x0E8 | 0x3663B4 | 0x3669F4 |
| variation | 0x60 | 16 | 0x1A0 | 0x366A94 | 0x36A2D4 |
| ins1 | 0x48 | 12 | 0x110 | 0x36A874 | 0x36EBF4 |
| ins2 | 0x48 | 12 | 0x158 | 0x36CA34 | 0x36EBF4 |

The upload address per kind is the register-0 write before each pass (0x8000 | address).
Reverb types: 4 (Hall 1/2, Room, Plate ...); variation 16; insertion 12 per slot.
